Moved to Portugal two days before the call on a 1-year architecture contract, so the house is empty. Smaller bedroom is currently his office (3D printers, equipment) and must be cleared. Holds all the keys. Plans to buy 2-3 more properties in DN1-DN5 if year one performs and retire to Portugal.

meeting_flow.opening_phrase: So, this is your residential property at the moment then?
meeting_flow.pivot_to_business: Have you got any questions I can sort of go through about how the service works?
meeting_flow.income_intro: So this is the report we've done for your property. So we can see here gross revenue of about £44,300 ... comes out at about £23,000 of net revenue. So it'll be like £1,900 a month.
meeting_flow.how_it_works_transition: I can give you an overview of renting it out ... we're going to be dealing with everything to do with the guests
meeting_flow.pre_close_setup: the only thing really we need from you is key safes or a place where we can collect the keys from. Everything else, we can sort out.
meeting_flow.close_phrase: What I'll do afterwards is I'll just sort of summarize everything we've spoken about, put a bit of an action plan together with the projections, and then obviously our agreement as well.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: how your company is going to actually charge me the fees ... and how I'm going to get paid, like monthly or weekly
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Revenue collected on his behalf and paid out monthly between the 1st and 5th; PDF statement sent on the 1st.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: I need the guideline, the sort of stuff you are expecting me to leave in the property ... how I'm going to hand in the keys to you and how our contract will be
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Covers guest comms, multi-platform listing, pricing, cleaning, laundry, maintenance, key management, guest vetting with £350 deposit and ID check; only access needed is keys or key safes.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Honestly speaking, I got all set of key with me now.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: And that's the net, net you're saying, not gross, isn't it? ... Right, and of course all bills, that's on me, isn't it?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Confirmed net payout, and that the only costs he pays from it are his current bills.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Can I transform it to a business property?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Set up a limited company, do a company let and send the payout to the company, then 'that would qualify' and business rates 'should be zero'. (Later corrected by email: self-catering rating needs availability and let-day thresholds, then small business rate relief.)
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Of course I have no idea about it. Maybe you can kindly give me the direction.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: As long as I know whatever you're promising me ... that is rigid and you're guaranteeing me that, I'm more than happy. And I can commit for a year.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Risk is low, no mortgage, profitable in worst, likely and best case; accuracy normally within 10-15%; about 6 months to hit the figures in a low-competition market.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Number one, no point keeping the house empty.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: one room set up as my office ... I don't know how we are going to work
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Can't list a 1-bed in this way, the figures don't work; recommended clearing the room and buying a sofa bed.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: I'm gonna order a sofa bed, double one ... use their shed to put my office stuff.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Do you advise me to change it for a sofa bed instead if you're wanting the best returns?
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: Yes, it makes the figures considerably more likely and may beat them; will send a link to a reputable sofa bed supplier and a key safe link.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: It would be kind if you please select which one.

lead_responses.what_lead_said: Please send me all the terms and conditions, all the documentation, whatever I need before I sign the contract.
lead_responses.zac_responded_with: That'll all be covered in the agreement I send you; will email and drop a WhatsApp when sent.
lead_responses.lead_follow_up: Yeah, very kind. Thank you very much, Zach.

conversion_gaps.gap: Lead wants firm guarantees ('rigid', 'guaranteeing') but Zac only gave projections with a 10-15% range; no explicit statement that earnings cannot be guaranteed
conversion_gaps.evidence: "whatever you're promising me ... that is rigid and you're guaranteeing me that, I'm more than happy"
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: State plainly that earnings are a projection, then guarantee the things Stayful controls: payout dates, statements, communication

conversion_gaps.gap: Business rates advice was wrong on the call: a Ltd company let does not itself make rates zero
conversion_gaps.evidence: "I would set up a limited company, do a rental agreement ... Then that would qualify." and "that should be zero"
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Corrected in email and plan: self-catering rating needs 140 days available and 70 days let; small business rate relief may then apply

conversion_gaps.gap: Presentation says no setup, monthly or exit fee but the agreement has a £42/month software fee and a £1,000 early-exit fee in the first 6 months; fees were not discussed on the call
conversion_gaps.evidence: Fees raised by Arif only as 'how your company is going to actually charge me' and answered with payout timing; no mention of software or exit fee
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: State agreement terms accurately in the plan, fix presentation copy, and flag fees before signing

conversion_gaps.gap: Projection excludes the 1-bed risk: figures assume 2 bedrooms but the office room is still full
conversion_gaps.evidence: "unfortunately, unless I don't come back, you cannot have that room as a room"
conversion_gaps.how_to_fill: Make clearing the room and sofa bed purchase explicit pre-conditions before go-live
